column1: # tools/shots/ink_ref.tsv (1.4 D0b, D0c; docs/M7D_CONTRACT.md §3.5 (f), docs/M7D.md D0b): the demo handwriting tiles of
# complete CI photos, for tools/shots/ink_check.swift (its head has the line's format). Made with `ink_check ref <photo>
# <name>`, every line from photos of Xcode 27.2 27B52 on iOS 27.2 24B8117 (iPad mini: iOS 27.0 24A434). The J-4 lines
# (a bare file name) come from the `screenshots` of run 44632524223 attempt 2 (image 20261104.0337.1; the iPhone's
# landscape photos in the shape simctl writes them on iOS 27.2, 2622x1206); the l10n lines (<folder>/<file>) from the
# complete photos of that run's `l10n-screenshots` (attempt 1, image 20261119.0378.1), except the last 11 lines
# (en/ipad13-portrait-week.png … zh-Hant/iphone-portrait-year.png): those photos lost handwriting in that attempt, so
# their lines come from the `l10n-screenshots` of D0b's run 44676125566 (attempt 1, r14 755d611, image 20261104.0337.1;
# every photo take 1, the 50 checked ones complete). Until D0c these 11 came from 1.3's run 44474759145 (Xcode 26.6).
# Sheets other than the lasso are left out. A name not here is not checked. A line is renewed with `ink_check ref` from
